expo.name: Graft
expo.description: Talk through the job, get a priced quote, send it on WhatsApp. Built for UK tradespeople.

infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Graft listens while you talk through a job so it can write the quote for you.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Graft turns what you say into a priced quote.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Graft uses your location to find the cheapest materials at merchants near you.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Graft uses the camera to add site photos to your quotes.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Graft lets you add site photos from your gallery to your quotes.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Graft adds jobs you book in to your calendar.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Graft adds jobs you book in to your calendar.
